name: Simple Task Manager
summary: A web application to manage tasks locally, allowing users to add, mark as complete, and delete tasks. Tasks are saved persistently between app restarts.
requirements: User can add new tasks with a title and description.
User can mark a task as complete.
acceptance_criteria: A user can add a new task with a title and description.
A user can mark a task as complete, and the task's status changes accordingly.
A user can delete a task, and it is removed from the list.
The application loads tasks saved from previous sessions upon startup.

tasks.title: Set up Flask project
tasks.description: Create a new Flask project with a basic structure.

tasks.title: Design the database schema
tasks.description: Define a model for tasks using sqlite3, including fields for title, description, completion status, and timestamp.

tasks.title: Implement routes for task management
tasks.description: Create Flask routes to handle adding, marking as complete, and deleting tasks.

tasks.title: Create HTML templates
tasks.description: Design HTML templates for the task manager interface, including forms for adding tasks and a list to display tasks.

tasks.title: Implement JavaScript for user interactions
tasks.description: Add JavaScript to handle user interactions with the form and list, updating the UI based on user actions.

tasks.title: Write backend tests
tasks.description: Create unit tests for the Flask routes to ensure they handle tasks correctly.

tasks.title: Write browser tests
tasks.description: Create tests to ensure the HTML and JavaScript work as expected in a web browser.

tasks.title: Persist tasks across sessions
tasks.description: Modify the application to save tasks to the sqlite3 database and load them on startup.

objective: Build a simple task manager where I can add tasks, mark them complete, and delete them. Save tasks between app restarts.
